verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own DGX B300 user guide publishes per-GPU memory capacity (288 GB per B300, 2.3 TB total across 8 GPUs). Nothing in the pack states the memory type, bus width, or bandwidth, so only one of the four required specs is evidenced. Missing for 10: memory type (e.g., HBM generation), memory bus width, memory bandwidth figure, and independent corroboration of the specs.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, memory specs are published in full for this exact part — capacity, memory type, bus width, and bandwidth

citations.quote: 8 x NVIDIA B300 Blackwell Ultra GPUs ... GPU memory 8 x 288 GB = 2.3 TB total
